TEXT: [FI] The day after the tournament.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Akihabara is bustling as ever.
[FI] This area is often seen as an "Otaku's Den", but really, it's quite sophisticated.
[FI] The public square in front of the station is pretty clean; it makes the place spacious and relaxing.
[FI] Saori and Kuroneko have already arrived and are sitting on a bench in the public square.
[FI] Oh right, the first time that I met Saori and Kuroneko was in Akihabara as well...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Well then, to celebrate the end of the tournament, to the holy land we came!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Let's go shop around since we're here, alright?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Shopping...
[FI] There wouldn't be any atmosphere to it if we were to celebrate immediately. This might be good to raise the tension.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, alright. Do you guys agree?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] It's fine with me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I don't mind; do what you want.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You heard them, Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I got it! Well then, where should we go first?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is there any place that you'd recommend?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Every place in Akihabara is recommended... Hmm...
[FI] And so Saori pondered for a while.
[FI] She's probably searching through the endless "Akiba-data" inside her head.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] How about we go to 【Radio Kaikan】 or 【AniMate】?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-shi, do you have any places that you would like to visit?
[FI] ...*gulp*
[FI] It seems simple enough, but in reality, the answer may be of crucial importance.
[FI] If I were to choose a place they don't care about, I'm sure that it would turn into some quarrel again.
[FI] Hmm... Where should we go?
[FI] Also, I shouldn't choose a tiring place...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What do we actually do at Radio Kaikan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-What's wrong? W-W-W-What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Radio Kaikan! I want to go to Radio Kaikan!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's with Radio Kaikan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Because Radio Kaikan has a figurine shop and there's a special 【Sis×Sis】 booth that started selling limited edition goodies!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sis×Sis - Sister Sister: Siscon Love Story?
[FI] ...*sigh*.
[FI] I'm getting quite familiar with such topics.
[FI] The contents are... that of a bishoujo game.
[FI] Because the story is about having a love triangle relationship with your little sisters "Rinko" and "Miyabi", my head hurts.
[FI] According to Kirino, it's a "tear-jerking" "godly game". But I frankly don't get it.
[FI] However, I do know how to make my own little sister cry...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Stop dilly-dallying! They'll be sold out if we don't hurry up!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] They won't be sold out that quickly. Calm down a bit. You'll hurt yourself if you panic.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Sis×Sis is a "godly game"!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, hey! Don't run!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Damn! I want this! This too! And that too!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] A-Aren't you buying too much?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Shut it! How I spend my own money is up to me!
[FI] This girl, she practically spent all her wages earned as a model, on "Sis×Sis"...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] What a big haul! I'm so happy!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Isn't that great, Kiririn-shi.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It isn't that bad to observe humans acting like that every once in a while.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] You're still speaking like that～ I can lend them to you if you're interested.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Wha...? Who said such a thing...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Look, look. You want to try them out too, don't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hahaha! Deepening mutual bonds through games! Ah, how wonderful!
[FI] Well, she's looking all happy and everything... Oh well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What do you do in AniMate?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ohh! As expected of Kyousuke-shi, good choice!
[FI] Saori shaped her mouth like that of a cat, and threw her head back.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] It seems that today, there's Morimura Kaede-dono doing an autograph session at AniMate!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Seriously?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] This is true, is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Who's that?
[FI] Not just Kirino, but even the usually expressionless Kuroneko had a reaction... This person must really be something.
[FI] Recently, I've been getting more and more familiar with "that genre of topics", but I'm still an amateur after all.
[FI] Just hearing the name isn't enough for me to recognize it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Holy crap! We have to hurry! DASH!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, hey! Don't run!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Oh man... I can't stop shaking.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I can't believe I got to shake hands with Morimura Kaede-san... This isn't a dream, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Even for an Akihabara veteran like me, it's been a long time since I got so excited...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It was quite impressive...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Did you see? Kaede-san held my hand gently and winked at me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Wasn't yours just a normal blink? The one she gave me was a wink.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I've decided! I will never wash my hands!
[FI] Uwah... That's such a classic reaction...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-shi, thank you very much for considering my feelings.
[FI] Saying that, Saori held out her hands to me. Then...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Ah, well. It's not like that...
[FI] I held out my right hand...
[FI] Careful now!!
[FI] I held out my left hand and shook hands with Saori...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...By the way, what kind of person is Morimura Kaede?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Kaede-shi is not only a writer, but also a singer, model and star; truly a multi-talented person!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Rumor has it she's participating in a Broadway musical next...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] That's amazing, isn't it! I totally admire her!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, I see.
[FI] ...I don't.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I don't mind where we go....

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I see... That's a shame.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Eeeh? We've already come to Akiba, so I wanna go somewhere at least!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's right, the four of us are together now. Vainly wasting our time goes against the rules of my soul.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] You mean you want to have fun, right? You're being way too cryptic.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Would you stop summarizing other people's speeches...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hahaha, you two sure get along with each other.
[FI] I get exhausted every time I go around Akiba with these girls.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Then what about relaxing in a Maid Cafe?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh! That's a good idea!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Huh...
[FI] Ignoring Kirino's lingering glare, we headed for a Maid Cafe.
